name: Bidirectional Cis-Trans Count-Likelihood PMI Retrieval with Within-Cluster Deviance Weighting
summary: Rather than compressing cells into a global latent vector, this plan scores cross-modal pairing directly in count space via bidirectional Pointwise Mutual Information. A forward Cis-Attention plus Trans-LSI Negative-Binomial decoder evaluates unsmoothed query RNA counts from candidate ATAC profiles, while a reverse dropout-aware encoder scores candidate ATAC accessibility against a marginal depth baseline. Inner-split excess-deviance gene weights prioritize within-cluster regulatory variation across nested 5-fold cross-validation. Benchmarking against all required floors, linear alignment, and split-half ceilings establishes whether retrieval achieves single-cell, sub-cluster, or cluster-only resolution.
analysis_unit: Individual cell (single nucleus with co-measured RNA and ATAC in development splits)
preprocessing: Partition 7,288 paired development cells into 5 disjoint outer folds at cell level; split each outer training set 85%/15% into inner_train (~4,955 cells) and inner_val (~875 cells) with zero cell overlap.

Fit TF-IDF and 96-component truncated SVD strictly on inner_train binarised ATAC peaks, drop component 1, and linearly residualise remaining 95 LSI components against inner_train log ATAC fragment depth.

Select the top 6,000 in-scope genes on inner_train by nonzero UMI variance and cis-peak linkage; attach static genomic annotations (multi-scale exponential TSS-distance basis at 2/15/75/250 kb and promoter/distal flag) to up to 24 cis-peaks per gene, depth-normalising candidate cis-peak counts.

Construct RNA encoder inputs per cell from log1p-CP10K counts concatenated with per-gene Poisson dropout log-probabilities (-L_q * pi_train_g) so shallow-depth zeros are distinguished from biological repression without cross-cell smoothing.

Fit inner_train unsupervised k=20 k-means on depth-free ATAC LSI (for Floor 3 and within-cluster deviance calculation) and compute inverse local k-NN (k=15) density sample weights clipped to [0.5, 5.0] in inner_train PCA+LSI space to upweight rare populations without WNN labels.
Fit per-peak marginal logistic ATAC depth models logit P0(y_cp > 0 | D_c) = alpha_p + beta_p * log(D_c) strictly on inner_train across the 25,000 cis-linked peaks.

training.loss: Inverse-density-weighted sum of exact forward Negative-Binomial NLL (with query UMI exposure L_q and simplex-constrained ATAC-predicted gene rates), reverse marginal-calibrated Bernoulli LLR NLL over cis-linked peaks, and auxiliary in-batch symmetric PMI margin loss (margin 0.1).
training.convergence_audit: Record per-epoch inner_train and inner_val NB deviance, Bernoulli LLR, and retrieval MRR; require monotonic smoothing and early-stopping convergence verification before unlocking outer_test evaluation.

validation.scoring_protocol: Score each outer_test query RNA profile strictly independently against unsmoothed candidate ATAC profiles (both primary ~1,458-cell fold pool and secondary ~4,582-cell pool adding 3,124 held-out ATAC-only distractors) using deterministic mid-ranks for ties; assert programmatically that batch=1 and full-batch query scoring match within 1e-6.
comparators_on_identical_splits: Floor 0: permutation null (uniform random ranking + analytical harmonic expectation check)
Floor 1: sequencing depth matching (inner_train OLS mapping query log RNA UMI to expected log ATAC fragments)
Floor 2: unlearned promoter-plus-proximal gene activity cosine similarity
Floor 3: inner_train k=20 cluster centroid matching with deterministic mid-rank tie handling
Simple linear reference: inner_train linear CCA alignment (64 components) on RNA PCA and depth-filtered ATAC LSI
Noise-ceiling ruler: binomial-thinning (p=0.5) split-half unimodal self-retrieval on outer_test cells
validation.statistical_inference: 2,000-resample paired nonparametric bootstrap across all 7,288 out-of-fold query cells for 95% CIs on MRR and paired differences versus every floor and linear reference; post-hoc WNN-stratified MRR and Recall@1 across all 19 populations controlled via Benjamini-Hochberg at 5% FDR.

metrics: Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) with deterministic mid-ranks for ties (primary)
Exact top-1, top-5, and top-10 retrieval rates (Recall@1, Recall@5, Recall@10)
Post-hoc within-population and macro-averaged MRR and Recall@1 across 19 WNN cell types (BH 5% FDR)
Ratio of cross-modal MRR to binomial-thinning unimodal split-half self-retrieval noise ceiling
Candidate-pool scaling retention from 1,458 paired candidates to 4,582 distractor-augmented candidates
allowed_conclusions: Select one of the four objective conclusions solely from paired-bootstrap 95% CIs on identical unseen cells: single-cell resolution requires high Recall@1 approaching the split-half ceiling and 95% CI > 0 over Floor 3 and linear CCA; sub-cluster neighborhood resolution requires 95% CI > 0 over Floors 0-3 (and linear reference if nonlinear complexity is claimed) while Recall@1 remains limited by single-cell sparsity; cell-type resolution holds if Floors 0-1 are beaten but Floor 3 is not; no biological retrieval holds otherwise. Scope strictly restricted to granulocyte-depleted PBMCs of this single healthy donor at this sequencing depth and pool size.
rationale: Simplex-constrained Negative-Binomial and depth-calibrated Bernoulli likelihood ratios separate true repression from sampling dropout (D1) while cancelling depth confounding (D5) and candidate hubness. Inner-split excess-deviance gene weights amplify within-cluster cis-regulatory variation beyond coarse identity (D6), and unsupervised inverse-density weights protect rare states without WNN labels (D2, D4).

new_components.name: bidirectional_cistrans_pmi_retriever
new_components.description: Per-feature bidirectional cross-modal count-likelihood scorer avoiding global bottleneck compression. Inputs: candidate depth-normalised cis_peaks with TSS-distance/promoter encodings, depth-residualised trans lsi, promoter gene_activity skip, raw query RNA UMI counts with total UMI exposure L_q, and candidate binarised cis-peaks with ATAC depth D_c. Forward head uses multi-head cis-attention modulated by trans-LSI to output simplex-normalised gene rates pi_cg (summing to 1, invariant to candidate depth) and per-gene NB dispersions r_g, scoring exact per-gene NB log-likelihoods of query RNA counts centered against a fixed inner_train RNA bank. Reverse head maps dropout-aware RNA inputs via a residual MLP and rank-64 bottleneck to cis-peak log-odds shifts over frozen inner_train marginal depth baselines logit P0(y_cp>0|D_c), computing exact depth-deconfounded Bernoulli log-likelihood ratios. Outputs: per-(query, candidate) PMI matrix combining forward NB scores (weighted by inner_val total and beyond-k20-cluster deviance explained) and reverse Bernoulli LLRs using inner_val-selected hyperparameters, scoring each query independently.
